Credited 600 dpi print-ready fan rendition of [[Dantooine (Dark)]], from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. This is a qualified comparison, not the official D-E1 source face.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Dantooine _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zJpL6FZdvKy_rank_y4-7rkig1dePBuM/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Dantooine _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,338,284 bytes, SHA-256 <code>6e2ceb07e16b685a7b9e10f20f82dd835aa25af60be9ad2aa9d87ad0e9d27835</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited original-style gold-E fan rendition remains a qualified comparison, separate from the official D-E1 face at [[Dantooine (Dark) (PC Errata 4)]]. The original TIFF/master, credit and license provenance remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
